message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern thrillers, and some hidden gems you might enjoy for a spooky Friday night:

| # | Title | Year | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | A masterclass in psychological dread with iconic imagery and an unforgettable score. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | A chilling family saga that blends supernatural terror with raw emotional depth. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | A smart, socially conscious horror that keeps you guessing until the very end. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | A daylight nightmare—beautiful yet brutal, it subverts the usual “dark” horror aesthetic. |
| 5 | **It Follows** | 2014 | A modern folk‑tale vibe with a relentless, creeping threat that feels eerily plausible. |
| 6 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | A psychological horror that turns grief into a literal monster. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Tension built around silence; a fresh take on survival horror. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | A well‑crafted paranormal thriller that balances scares with character development. |
| 9 | **The Others** | 2001 | A haunting atmosphere and a twist that will keep you on edge. |
|10 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | A meta‑take on horror tropes that delivers both laughs and chills. |

Feel free to pick one or two depending on how intense you want your Friday night to be!
